output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS discounted_orders FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.discount_amount > 0
output.explanation: Counts orders dated in 2025 with a discount amount above zero. All statuses are included, as the question asks, so the completed-only revenue rule doesn't apply.
